text:
alex: Flagging docs PR #4912: request examples for /v1/embed show `input` as a string but runtime accepts array of strings too. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4912
maris: We intentionally simplified examples to a single string for brevity, but the OpenAPI schema allows `input: string | string[]`. The linter complains because samples must match schema precisely.
alex: Linter error: examples/openapi/embed.yaml sample type mismatch. docs-lint: example.typeMismatch -> expected array OR string.
docs-bot: Automated suggestion: expand example to show both shapes with a short note.
ton y: Suggestion: canonical example should show the array form (batching is common). Add a single-line note: "The `input` field accepts either a single string or an array of strings; array recommended for batching."
maris: I'll update the PR to replace the single-string sample with an array sample, and add a docs-callout. Also will sync SDK snippets to show array usage in JS and Go.
alex: Also add a tiny migration blurb: "Older examples sometimes used `data` as key; current API uses `input`."
docs-bot: CI: after changes, docs-lint passes. Preview: https://deploy-preview-4912--redwood-docs.netlify.app/reference/embed
maris: Pushed saml/embed-sample-fix. PTAL @alex @tony
ton y: LGTM. Merged. Follow-up: opened issue INFR-330 to add an example validator to docs CI to catch these mismatches earlier.
